Kernel analysis of the pinned 306-element canonical band of S45 (data SHA from frontier-20261029-source45-rightSN-canonical-result-v1.md): three D-classes. Two incomparable maximal 3x3 classes are swapped by C2, and their meet is a bottom 6x48 class. Every top element acts on the 48 bottom columns as a retraction with an 8-column image, and on rows as a constant. 12 columns are hit by source elements. Products of the identity-middle elements fall to the bottom exactly when the twist crosses to the other maximal class. This realizes non-unit sandwich entries.

Written lemma (two-layer extension, same-author, unreviewed): let B_T be an RSNB band with G-action, Omega an equivariant right B_T-act, and lambda: B_T -> Rows an equivariant map with lambda(xy)=lambda(x). Then B_T ⊔ (Rows x Omega) is an RSNB band, with products (r,w)(r',w')=(r,w'), x(r,w)=(lambda(x),w) and (r,w)x=(r,w.x). The local-monoid RRB check uses only that the act is an act of the band B_T.
